headline: Transnet Richards Bay Terminal Loads Record Volume of Chrome Ore
summary: South African state logistics provider Transnet achieved record chrome ore loading volumes at its Richards Bay terminal, mitigating export constraints seen at the nearby Port of Durban.
why: South Africa controls the world's largest reserves of chrome ore, essential for global stainless steel production.

impacts.name: South African Mining Sector
impacts.why: Record loading volumes at export terminals ease logistical delays for mining exporters.
